candidates.title: Toy demo: fine-tuning a 3.2M-param char transformer makes it forget Shakespeare (held-out numbers)
candidates.summary:
I pre-trained a 3.2M-parameter character-level transformer on Tiny Shakespeare (validation loss 1.50), then fine-tuned it for 1,000 steps on Mrs Beeton’s Book of Household Management (1861).

Results on text held out from both:

  • Recipe loss: 2.65 to 1.09
  • Shakespeare loss: 1.50 to 2.39

After fine-tuning, the prompt “ROMEO:” yields “377. INGREDIENTS.–4 oz. of salt”. A small, concrete example of forgetting.
